name: eas-update

summary.en: Expo’s official skill for over-the-air JavaScript updates with EAS Update: channels, branches, runtime versions and debugging.
summary.zh: Expo 官方 Skill，介绍用 EAS Update 做 OTA 更新：渠道、分支、runtime 版本与问题排查。

upstreamDescription: Configure and use EAS Update for over-the-air JavaScript and asset updates with expo-updates and EAS CLI. Use when setting up OTA updates, running eas update:configure or eas update, publishing to preview/staging/production channels, explaining branches/channels/runtime versions, testing updates, or debugging why an installed build still shows old code. Load for TestFlight, preview, or production updates that do not appear, including questions about cold launches or reopening the app. Not for update health metrics; use eas-update-insights for adoption, crashes, and rollout monitoring.
